title: Coanda 1936 lenticular aerodyne patent
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Coanda 1936 lenticular aerodyne patent, about 1936 at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Kanda uh actually filed a patent in 1936

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Henri Coanda, an aircraft engineer, filed a patent in 1936 for a "lenticular aerodyne," a lens-shaped flying machine much like a disc. Michels raises it because it would mean people were already designing saucer-like craft years before the wave of flying saucer reports began.
